title: Chicago Walking Tour: Art Deco Skyscrapers Loop
includes: Admission to the Galleries of the Chicago Architecture Center
Narration by a professional and certified Guide
Walking tour of Downtown Chicago Art Deco architecture
Hotel pick up and drop off (not included)
Storage for luggage or strollers (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Access to building interiors featured on this tour may be subject to change, due to weekend and holiday schedules or unforeseen closures.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
View Art Deco masterpieces built in the heart of Chicago’s financial district during the Roaring '20s. Learn how Art Deco reflected the era’s fun-loving optimism with lavish materials and geometric ornament.

Discover the origins of Art Deco and its hallmark motifs while admiring buildings like the Chicago Board of Trade, One LaSalle Street and the Field Building (now the Bank of America Building) -- all of which are designated Chicago landmarks.

As a certified nonprofit, all CAC ticket purchases directly support our education efforts and community engagement projects.
